certification_basis.raw_reference: For the basic PA-32R-301 Saratoga II HP aeroplane the applicable certification basis is based on CAR 3 and FAR23 (for details on the applicable amendments and paragraphs see A.V., note 5).

For PA-32R-301 Saratoga II HP aeroplanes equipped with the factory installed Avidyne Entegra System option the additional certification basis for installation specific items only is defined in CRI-A01 (for details on applicable paragraphs see A.V., note 6).
CAR 3 and FAR 23 for the basic PA-32R-301 Saratoga II HP aeroplane (for applicable amendments see A.II.4)
CAR 3, FAR 23 and JAR-23 for PA-32R-301 Saratoga II HP aeroplanes equipped with the factory installed Avidyne Entegra System option (for applicable amendments see A.II.4)
None for the basic PA-32R-301 Saratoga II HP aeroplane
